source: trade practice and the building code: what the trades install inside or through the building's assemblies on purpose is construction, not a clash (Q6621)
runs_source: a run and its fittings: the pieces a trade drops down a wall's cavity, stacks in a wall, lays in a floor's bays or takes through an assembly
supports_source: a strap, hanger or support is fastened to the building by definition
gear_pieces_source: a breaker stands inside its panel: where the panel meets something, the panel's clash says so
cavity_source: trade practice: in-wall drops and stacks, runs in a floor's joist bays and raceways embedded in a slab are how the trades install them (the framing members are judged by their own hole rules)
casework_source: trade practice: a device or box set in or at casework is mounted in the casework's face or the wall behind it, as its layout places it; the drop feeding it and a sink's supplies and trap run in the wall behind it or the cabinet's base (a duct is not set in casework)
through_wall_source: trade practice: a packaged terminal unit, a sidewall fan or a louver is set through its wall in a sleeve or framed opening
recessed_source: a schedule's MOUNTING (or the equipment's own words) that sets it into its wall (wordrules equipment.in_wall_mounting_words); a can deeper than its wall comes out of the far face, a real conflict

penetrations.seal: none for fire (a floor on grade): the vapor retarder or waterproofing sealed round the item
penetrations.seal_firestop: a listed through-penetration firestop system where the floor/ceiling assembly is rated, else the annular space filled with an approved material
penetrations.sleeve: a sleeve, cored or cut opening sized for the item and its seal

by_category.pipe: a pipe sleeve (a cored hole or cast-in sleeve in concrete, a cut hole in a framed floor)
by_category.duct: a framed opening (a fire damper or a rated shaft where the floor is rated, IBC 717)
by_category.conduit: a cored or cut hole (a raceway needs no sleeve)

penetrations.source: IBC 714.5 (rated floor/ceiling assemblies) and 714.6 (unrated floors: annular space sealed); NEC 300.21 for electrical; IPC 305 for piping

penetrations.seal: no firestop (the wall's type has no fire rating): the opening closed by the finish
penetrations.seal_firestop: a listed through-penetration firestop system for the wall's rating
penetrations.sleeve: a bored hole in a framed wall, a sleeve or cored hole through concrete or masonry

by_category.duct: a framed opening (a fire damper where the wall is rated, IBC 717)
by_category.equipment: the unit's wall sleeve in a framed opening

penetrations.source: IBC 714.4 (penetrations of fire-resistance-rated walls); NEC 300.21 for electrical; IPC 305 for piping

penetrations.seal: roof flashing round the item (a pipe boot, a curb or a pitch pocket) by the roofer
penetrations.sleeve: a cut opening in the deck, flashed

penetrations.seal: a membrane penetration: the ceiling closed round the item (a rated ceiling membrane is sealed as its floor/ceiling assembly's listing says)
penetrations.sleeve: a cut opening in the ceiling
penetrations.source: IBC 714.5 (membrane penetrations of rated floor/ceiling assemblies)
